sources.snippet: A reproduction of the Anthropic / Bricken et al. 2023 SAE recipe — applied to GPT-2 small's residual stream. Trains a one-hidden-layer ReLU autoencoder on cached transformer hidden states with an L1 sparsity penalty, then surfaces the top-activating tokens for each learned feature so you can see what the model has decomposed into.
